title: PVGANDHI AWARD EXCELLENCE IN PUBLICLIFE-News
summary: THE RCB P V GANDHI AWARD FOR EXCELLENCE IN PUBLIC LIFE TO IAS ASHWINI BHIDE, Managing Mumbai's Momentum.
description:
THE RCB P V GANDHI AWARD FOR EXCELLENCE IN PUBLIC LIFE TO IAS ASHWINI BHIDE, Managing Mumbai's Momentum. AS Ashwini Bhide in conversation with PP Vineet Bhatnagar on ‘From Metro Tunnels to Municipal Challenges: The Making of Mumbai 2.0’. She reflected on her journey as Mumbai’s first woman Municipal Commissioner. • Technology and data-driven decisions helped Mumbai navigate the COVID-19 pandemic. • Coordinated planning remains vital to delivering the city’s ambitious infrastructure projects • Cleaner air, improved water supply
and sustainable urban development remain key priorities. Members 112, Partners 16, Guest 9, Rotaractors 3 taking total 140. Covered in Free Press Journal. https://www.freepressjournal.in/mumbai/rotary-club-of-bombay-honours-bmc-commissioner-ashwini-bhide-with-award-for-excellence-in-public-life
